stories.title: Krieg gegen die Ukraine: Donald Tusk warnt vor russischen Angriffen auf Verbündete der Ukraine

en.title: War against Ukraine: Donald Tusk warns of Russian attacks on Ukraine's allies
en.summary: According to Polish intelligence, Russia is planning hybrid attacks against countries supporting Ukraine. The EU has announced billions in aid for Ukraine.

stories.title: US-Einwanderungsbehörde ICE: Trump zieht Vorschlag für Leitung von ICE-Behörde zurück

en.title: US immigration agency ICE: Trump withdraws proposal for leadership of ICE agency
en.summary: Donald Trump has withdrawn his personnel nomination for the leadership position of the controversial US immigration agency ICE. Lance Schroyer was the proposed candidate.

stories.title: Donald Trump: Präsident zieht Nominierung von ICE-Kandidat Lance Schroyer zurück

en.title: Donald Trump: President withdraws nomination of ICE candidate Lance Schroyer
en.summary: President Trump has reversed course and withdrawn his nomination of former police officer Lance Schroyer for the top position at US immigration agency ICE, without providing a reason.

stories.title: ZDF-»Politbarometer Extra«: SPD überholt AfD in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern knapp

en.title: ZDF Politbarometer Extra: SPD narrowly overtakes AfD in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern
en.summary: In a poll ahead of the Mecklenburg-Vorpommern state election, the SPD narrowly leads the AfD. The CDU and Greens would enter parliament, while the BSW would not.

stories.title: SPD überholt laut Umfrage AfD in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Linke in Berlin vorn

en.title: SPD overtakes AfD in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern according to poll, Left leads in Berlin
en.summary: A new poll shows the SPD could become the strongest party in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, reversing its previous significant deficit behind the far-right AfD. The CDU/CSU Union faces a historically poor result.

stories.title: Neue Erhebung: Umfrage: Linke knapp vor CDU bei Berlin-Wahl

en.title: New Survey: Left Party Narrowly Ahead of CDU in Berlin Election
en.summary: A recent survey shows the Left Party leading the CDU by a narrow margin ahead of Berlin's election.

stories.title: Brandanschlag auf Synagoge in Wuppertal - Verdächtiger festgenommen

en.title: Arson attack on synagogue in Wuppertal - suspect arrested
en.summary: A man allegedly threw a bag containing flammable liquid at a synagogue building in Wuppertal, and the suspect was taken into custody by police.

stories.title: Polen: Donald Tusk warnt vor russischen Drohnenangriffen auf Ukraine-Verbündete

en.title: Poland: Donald Tusk warns of Russian drone attacks on Ukraine allies
en.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk says Russia has a plan to attack supporters of Ukraine, with the goal of weakening NATO cohesion.

stories.title: Liveblog Ukrainekrieg: Tusk warnt vor „hybriden Angriffen“ Russlands auf Verbündete der Ukraine

en.title: Ukraine War Live Blog: Tusk warns of 'hybrid attacks' by Russia on Ukraine's allies
en.summary: Polish Prime Minister Tusk warned that Russia aims to weaken NATO cohesion through hybrid attacks. The US Congress approved stricter Russia sanctions, and discussions continued on European air defense capabilities.

stories.title: Friedrich Merz: Was die Wahlen in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern und Berlin für den Kanzler bedeuten

en.title: Friedrich Merz: What the elections in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Berlin mean for the Chancellor
en.summary: Upcoming state elections in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Berlin may impact Friedrich Merz's political position as Chancellor, with pressure on his leadership appearing to ease only temporarily.

stories.title: Wohnte am Flughafen: Weiterer Malaria-Patient in Frankfurt gestorben

en.title: Lived near airport: Another malaria patient in Frankfurt dies
en.summary: Three people have died from so-called airport malaria in Frankfurt, with infections in the airport vicinity becoming known only this week.

stories.title: Rohstoffe: JP Morgan – Ölmarkt wegen Iran-Kriegs nicht mehr prognostizierbar

en.title: Commodities: JP Morgan – Oil market no longer predictable due to Iran conflict
en.summary: JP Morgan stated that six months into the Iran conflict with no resolution in sight, the oil market has become too unpredictable to model accurately.

stories.title: ZDF-Politbarometer: Umfrage sieht SPD in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern vor der AfD

en.title: ZDF Political Barometer: Poll shows SPD ahead of AfD in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern
en.summary: A new poll released days before the Mecklenburg-Vorpommern state election shows the SPD leading the AfD, with some results proving unexpected.

stories.title: +++ Iran-Krieg +++: Italien will Meerenge Bab al-Mandab im Roten Meer allein sichern

en.title: Iran Crisis: Italy Wants to Secure Bab al-Mandab Strait in Red Sea Alone
en.summary: Italy seeks to independently secure the Bab al-Mandab strait amid regional tensions. The United States clears the way for a potential F-35 fighter jet sale to Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: +++ Ukraine-Krieg +++: Trump stellt Polen Stützpunkt der US-Armee in Aussicht

en.title: Ukraine War: Trump Offers Poland US Army Base
en.summary: Trump indicates the possibility of providing Poland with a US military base. Putin places Russian subsidiaries of Nestlé and Auchan under temporary administration.

stories.title: Putin-Kritiker: Michail Chodorkowski im Interview: „Ich bin absolut sicher, dass Putin eine Mobilmachung braucht“

en.title: Putin Critic: Mikhail Khodorkovsky in Interview: "I am Absolutely Certain that Putin Needs Mobilization"
en.summary: Former Russian oligarch Mikhail Khodorkovsky discusses what Russian parliamentary elections reveal, his assessment of Putin's mental state, and what he considers the West's fundamental strategic error.
